subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice@acmehealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — Pilot kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood to power Acme Health’s patient summarization flow (internal demo + 2 pilot endpoints).
- Expected workload: mainly chat/generation with some embeddings for search. You mentioned ≈3M tokens over 30 days as a rough estimate, with 70% generation and 30% embeddings.
- Success criteria: parity on summary quality vs. internal baseline + latency under 1s p50 for typical requests.

Open items / asks for qualification:
1) Confirm expected total token volume for the pilot window (30 days) — you mentioned ~3M, can you confirm actual expected daily burn?
2) Budget range for pilot and target unit economics (what’s your target $/1M tokens for production)?
3) Any regulatory or compliance evidence we should collect early (SOC2, data residency)?

Pilot credits and extension:
- Based on the burn estimates we discussed, I can request a credits extension to cover the pilot so you can complete evaluation without interruptions. Please confirm the tokens you need covered and the ideal pilot end date.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm final token numbers and budget range (reply to this thread).
- I’ll request credits from Finance/RevOps (cc’ing Monica + Marissa for approval).
- CS (Monica) will schedule a technical check-in to optimize batch settings / KV caching to control burn.

Attachment: I’ve attached a short template to capture daily burn and ROI assumptions (Acme_Pilot_Burn_Rate_Sheet.xlsx).

If you can reply with the token confirmation today, I’ll push for a quick approval.

Thanks!
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alice Johnson <alice@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks — Pilot kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. Quick confirmations below: 

- Expected token volume: ~3,000,000 tokens over the 30-day pilot (roughly 100k tokens/day average, but we expect spikes up to ~400k/day during internal testing).
- Budget range: for the evaluation we have $3k–$5k allocated this quarter for the POC. For production we’d target roughly $1k–$1.2k per 1M tokens (we know this will vary by model and quantization).
- Compliance: SOC2 type II report is required; we’ll want to review Data Residency options if we trouble-shooting production later.

We’d like to request a credits extension to cover the pilot — ideally 2,000,000 tokens to ensure the team can run the full test matrix without hitting rate limits. Can you confirm what you can approve?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Johnson
Director, ML Systems | Acme Health
alice@acmehealth.com

Subject: Request: approve pilot credits for Acme Health (ACME-4532) — 2M tokens requested

Marissa / Rishi —

Can you please review and approve a pilot credits extension for Acme Health? Details below: 

- Account: Acme Health (ACME-4532)
- AE: Neha Kapoor
- CS: Monica Patel (cc’d)
- Pilot window: 30 days starting on approval
- Requested credits: 2,000,000 tokens (requested by customer)
- Observed/expected burn: ~100k tokens/day avg, spikes to ~400k/day during test runs (see attached burn-rate sheet)
- Budget: customer indicated $3k–$5k for the evaluation; target $/1M tokens for production ~ $1k–$1.2k
- Business rationale: They need uninterrupted runs for their internal QA matrix to validate quality and latency. If pilot demonstrates parity, this is a likely mid-market deal for Redwood (ACME-4532) with potential Dedicated capacity requirement.

Recommended approval: 1.5M tokens now, with option to top-up an additional 500k if they show high burn in first 10 days. This mitigates risk while still enabling their test matrix. Estimated list-equivalent cost at $1,200 / 1M tokens: ~ $1,800 credited value for 1.5M.

Attachments: Acme_Pilot_Burn_Rate_Sheet.xlsx (daily burn estimate).

Thoughts? If we’re aligned I’ll confirm with the customer and get them scheduled with Monica for the technical check-in.

Thanks —
Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Neha —

Thanks for the summary and the recommendation. Approved to grant 1.5M tokens of pilot credits now. Please do the following: 
- Confirm pilot start date with the customer and issue a credits grant note (I’ll sign off on the grant in our system).
- If they exceed 1.5M in the first 10 days, loop me and Rishi immediately and we’ll review a top-up of 500k.
- Monica, please prioritize the technical check-in and provide quick optimizations (batching, token limits, model selection) to help control burn.

Also, add the estimated credit value to the deal record (HubSpot) and flag the renewal potential as "high" if success criteria are met.

Marissa Cole

Hi Alice / Tom —

Good news: Marissa approved a 1.5M token credits grant for Acme Health to cover the pilot. We’ll issue the grant today and it will appear in your console under the account. If you need the additional 500k right away, please call that out and we’ll triage within the first 10 days as discussed.

Practical notes to reduce burn while you run tests:
- Consider increasing batch size for non-interactive tests — that can cut per-token cost significantly.
- Use prefix caching for repeated prompts where possible.
- Monica will check model selection (lighter quantized variant) and rate limits during the technical check-in to optimize spend.

Next steps:
1) Monica (cc) — please share 2 available time slots for the technical optimization call next week.
2) Alice / Tom — confirm pilot start date (we can start immediate or schedule for next Mon 06/28).
3) I’ll push the credits into the account and share confirmation once complete.

Thanks — excited to get this running.
